name: Sweden: check of forms and supplied documents

common.check: Trial title and EU trial number (if assigned) match the protocol and CTIS.
Every field the assistant answers is answered; fields that belong to the site, investigator, insurer or issuing person are left empty, not invented.
The document is in Swedish (Annex I points 59 to 73); English only for an insurer-issued certificate where accepted. No Swedish and English duplicate of the same document is uploaded.
Where the shared EU form is used, its fixed English text is flagged as needs_decision until DECISIONS.md D1 is settled (Läkemedelsverket Swedish template or EU form).
No signature unless the current template's own signature or approval fields require one (N1 issuer; M1/M2 per template).
CTIS title follows the naming guide and requirements.json.

SE-K1.check: Uses the EU Recruitment and Informed Consent Procedure template v2.0 (new Part II submissions from 1 September 2026) or the current Läkemedelsverket Swedish template, and covers the current v2.0 fields.
Describes how potential participants are identified and what constitutes the first act of recruitment in Sweden.

The yes/no answers for incapacitated adults, minors, impartial witness and emergency match the project's populations and study facts; each 'yes' section is completed, each 'no' section says not applicable.

Consent is obtained by a licensed physician or licensed dentist who also conducts the Article 29 interview (HSLF-FS 2021:109), or the Läkemedelsverket exception and its protocol justification are described.

Minors: guardians as representatives, both guardians' signatures, own consent from 15 when the minor understands, own consent when turning 15 during the trial, information by a team member experienced with children, respect of refusal.
Adults without capacity: god man or förvaltare with authority over personal matters; participant involvement; capacity reassessment and move to own consent.

Impartial witness: reason the participant cannot write or sign, how the decision is expressed, witness selection and independence, what the witness observes and signs, how the reason is documented, how the participant receives a copy.

Emergency: triggering circumstances, assessment of inability to consent, why a representative cannot be reached in the therapeutic window, who decides and documents, information before the first intervention, subsequent approach, refusal of continued participation and handling of data already collected (Annex I point 62).
Recruitment routes and first act of recruitment match the recruitment material (K2) and the protocol.

SE-M1.check: One CV per responsible investigator and Swedish site, current.
Shows education, GCP training, clinical trial experience and patient-care experience appropriate to the trial.
In Swedish; the fields and execution instructions of the current template are followed.

SE-M2-DOI.check: One declaration per investigator and site; financial interests and institutional affiliations that could affect impartiality are answered by the investigator.
In Swedish; execution requirements of the current Swedish declaration template followed.

SE-N1.check: One statement per Swedish trial site; written justification covering facilities, equipment, staffing and expertise, specific to this protocol (Annex I point 67).
Issued by the head of the clinic or institution or another responsible person according to the applicable arrangement, using the template's signature or approval fields.
Site name, principal investigator and planned participant numbers match CTIS and M1/M2.

SE-O1.check: Documentation shows that participants can receive compensation through insurance or another arrangement where the sponsor or investigator becomes liable, proportionate to the nature and extent of the risk (Medicinal Products Act 2015:315).
The description of the Swedish insurance arrangement is in Swedish; any English insurer-issued certificate is attached only where accepted.
Insurer, cover and contact route match the injury-compensation wording in every participant document.

SE-O2.check: Proof of other coverage (for example sponsor-specific clinical trial insurance) provided where relevant and consistent with O1 and the participant documents.

SE-P1.check: Describes trial financing and payments or compensation to participants, investigators and sites, and other relevant sponsor-site financial arrangements (DECISIONS.md D3 for the part outside the EU form).
States explicitly when no participant compensation is offered.
Amounts, conditions and recipients identical to every participant document.
Incapacitated participants, their representatives and minors receive no incentives beyond compensation for expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation.

SE-FEE.check: Fee-related document and invoicing information prepared according to the current Läkemedelsverket instructions and placed in the CTIS area Läkemedelsverket instructs.
In Swedish unless the authority form specifies otherwise.

SE-R1.check: Contains the Swedish Part II statement on compliance with national requirements for the collection and use of personal data, in Swedish (Annex I point 73).
An English GDPR statement in the CTIS Form section is not used as a substitute.
Sponsor details match the CTIS application; data flows consistent with the participant documents.

SE-S1.check: New and archive sample sections match the protocol and sample plan; at least one is completed.
Collection, storage and use of samples are described fully, since use under the Biobank Act is linked to the authorised CTR application.
Biobank Act applicability, responsible biobank and the parallel biobank application are stated and consistent with the biobank application.
Analysis, storage, duration, access, coding, transfers, future use and withdrawal match the participant documents and R1.
